copy.headline: Ribbed crop tank with the leopard teardrop at the heart.
copy.description: A fine-rib stretch tank, cropped at the waist with a clean neckline and wide straps. At the centre chest, the signature teardrop cutout lined in the house leopard. Made to pair with the Dahlia Skirt — worn here in cream and caramel on the same shoot.
copy.atelierNotes: Ready-to-wear piece produced in limited runs. Leopard appliqué is fused and stitched by hand.
copy.editorialQuote: The quiet foundation — one leopard detail, cut with intention.

fabric.material: Fine-rib stretch knit with leopard appliqué
fabric.drapeDescription: Body-skimming stretch rib with quick recovery
fabric.finish: Matte rib surface, hand-applied print appliqué
fabric.careInstructions: Hand wash cold. Dry flat. Do not wring.
